rollups.text: Home-maintenance app project: on 2023-05-20, the user began planning a seasonal app to help homeowners reduce risks of water damage, fire, and other costly damage, with recurring maintenance tasks suited to older houses. The user established 12 categories and requested CSV descriptions; then requested at least 10 tasks per category, each with completion instructions, risk reduced, and an importance score. The assistant began the task tables, but the available transcript cuts off during Electrical, so completion of the full task set is not established. All recorded steps occurred on the same day; elapsed time between them is not specified.

Family heirloom digital archive: by 2023-05-25, the user planned a digital repository for family heirlooms, beginning with the vase inherited from the user's grandmother. The plan was to scan the appraisal report and other papers, photograph the vase from several angles, organize files into folders, add searchable metadata, and invite relatives to contribute stories, photos, and documents. The records show a plan, not whether the archive was completed; all milestones were reported on 2023-05-25.

Anxiety self-management: on 2023-05-29, the user reported anxiety attacks occurring more often, especially at night, and identified shoulder and neck tension. The user planned to continue 30-minute lunch walks three times weekly, add progressive muscle relaxation focused on the shoulders and neck, and keep an anxiety journal with relaxation ratings immediately after the walk and PMR. The user expected this routine to improve daytime relaxation and focus and planned to track its effects; outcomes are not recorded.

Desktop-computer troubleshooting: on 2023-05-28, the user reported intermittent freezes, especially while multitasking or running resource-intensive programs, on a Windows 10 desktop with an Intel Core i5, 16 GB RAM, and 1 TB HDD. The freezes lasted seconds to about a minute, without reported error messages or crashes. The user had cleaned the fans on 2023-05-21 and considered overheating unlikely. They planned to monitor resource use, run a disk check, and disable unnecessary startup programs; results were not reported in the available records.

Product-photography business and printmaking interests: on 2023-05-21, the user was creating a product-photography business and requested setting ideas for company product photos. By 2023-05-28, the user had been selected for a community-gallery printmaking workshop and wanted to experiment with relief printing, especially linocut. They planned a cityscape-inspired print drawing on Sarah Lee's nighttime photography, using varied inks and paper textures and possibly mixing abstract patterns and textures; they also planned to study Julie Mehretu's prints. The records do not establish whether the business launched, workshop occurred, or print was completed.

Board-game hobby development: the user started playing around late March 2023 and still considered themself new on 2023-05-25. By 2023-04-13, the user was playing Settlers of Catan with family every Sunday; the six-week period ending 2023-05-25 included repeated Sunday games. In May, the user also played Catan at a meetup, enjoyed Azul with friends, bought Carcassonne and Pandemic, and learned their rules using tutorials. The user planned a June birthday board-game party with a Game Night theme, gaming stations, and a snack-and-drinks station. The records do not confirm that the party took place.

From 2023-03-03 through 2023-03-20, the user recalled three online purchases in March: ASOS jeans on 2023-03-03, a Best Buy wireless charging pad on 2023-03-15, and sneakers from Amazon on 2023-03-20. The user believed these were the only three online purchases that month, though the records do not establish that the list was complete. The ASOS jeans were a semi-planned purchase after waiting for a denim sale; the charging pad was bought on sale after an online advertisement reminded the user of the need.

The user reported making 30-minute walks during lunch three times a week on 2023-05-29; these helped clear their head during the day. This is a reported weekly routine, not a count of completed walks over a known period.
